concept.title: Current Yield
concept.shortdesc: simply compares the coupon of a bond with its market price (Coupon of the bond

conbody.p: Current yield simply compares the coupon of a bond with its market price (Coupon of the bond divided by its market price). For example, if a bond paying an annual coupon of 12 percent is trading in the market for Rs. 109.50, then the current yield is: 12/109.5 = 10.95 percent. Current yield is a measure of return of a bond.
